name.ja: ケロロ軍曹プラモコレクション 藪医クルルロボ
name.en: Keroro Sergeant Plastic Model Collection Bush Doctor Kururu Robo

description.ja: 絶好調「ケロロ軍曹 特別訓練戦国ラン星大バトル！」より“藪医クルルロボ”が登場。
description.en: From ``Sergeant Keroro Special Training Sengoku Ran Star Great Battle!'' comes ``Kururu Robo, a bush doctor''.

description.ja: ロボ形態からシャチホコ形態に変形。
description.en: Transforms from robot form to killer whale form.

description.ja: 藪医クルルが乗った木馬型ソーサーは脱着可能。
description.en: The wooden horse-shaped saucer that the bush doctor Kururu rides on is removable.

description.ja: 武者ケロロロボ（別売り）や足軽タママロボ（別売り）とブロック感覚で合体遊びが可能。
description.en: You can play together with Musha Keroro Robo (sold separately) and Ashigaru Tamama Robo (sold separately) in a block-like manner.
